description.value: Pamir Diner is an Afghan restaurant in Delta, BC, serving traditional dishes including handcrafted mantu dumplings, slow-cooked lamb, and mixed kebab platters using family recipes. The menu draws on generations of Afghan culinary tradition with an emphasis on fresh, daily-prepared ingredients. Online ordering is available for pickup and delivery, making it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists riding through the area.
